hypothesis: Already admitted acyclic compact producers with one common terminal participation block can use the existing bounded canonical chunk scheduler when full-trip storage exceeds the checked ceiling. Keeping completed iterations independent of participation permits empty chunks, sparse conditional loads and retained producer state without affine chunking, new operation admission, a profitability threshold or original-loop vectorizability. Full-trip splitting remains preferred when its storage fits.
semantics: Chunk admission still requires zero-start/unit-step control whose next IV exits on equality, the existing finite representable count proof, and checked padded scratch and pointer-index sizing. The acyclic branch-only graph, single common terminal participation edge, exact use-edge closure of every moved accumulator, calls/effects, strictfp/constrained-FP and final-export restrictions are unchanged; all rejection checks precede mutation. For a chunk starting at base, K=min(N-base,C)>0. The original producer executes K original iterations and paths. A separate ordinal increments at each latch; its final completed count is exported through the compact guard and advances base. P starts at zero on each producer-preheader edge; only the original participation block stores at old P and increments it. Every bypass forwards P unchanged. Inductively 0<=P<=ordinal<K<=C before each producer iteration, every participating store index is <C, and on exit 0<=P<=completed=K<=C. The guard consumes exactly P initialized contributions in original participation order. P=0 executes no consumer load or accumulator update and forwards the incoming chunk accumulator, including signed zero, rather than the function-entry start. Nonempty and empty results merge before the chunk backedge. Existing retained-state snapshots forward simultaneous original backedges through the producer exit on every chunk, including empty chunks; current/next/final inactive exports remain separate. All producer blocks enter the new parent LoopInfo membership while remaining mapped to their inner loop. Dedicated exits, topmost SE invalidation, DT recomputation, stage metadata, source-located remarks and recursive LCSSA assertions are retained. Actual transformed scalar and vector/scalar-tail paths are registered against separately renamed exact original IR and an independent nonchunked C oracle, with per-chunk probes of completed/P/consumer conservation, original state/control, old-P stores, empty bypasses and current/next exports. Only the harness may execute this verification.
costs: No new streams, retained-state arrays, participation masks, input rereads, producer duplication or contribution recomputation. Reuse the existing chunk min/remainder controller, producer ordinal, accumulator carries and retained-state backedge forwarding. Composition adds one completed-count forwarding PHI and retains the existing compact empty-stream guard, nonempty dedicated exit and result merge for each chunk. One runtime P==0 branch per chunk; no versioning/alias guards. LoopInfo insertion is O(producer blocks), with the existing linear acyclic/effect/use/export analyses and at-most-64-step monotone padded-capacity search; no new path enumeration, SSA reconstruction or profitability machinery. For the new shared i32+double fixtures, scratch per capacity C is alignTo(4*C,8)+8*C: C=1/8/9/16/65 reserves 16/96/112/192/784 bytes. At 15 bytes no slot fits; 111 bytes fits C=8, 112 fits C=9. Logical traffic is 12 bytes stored and 12 loaded per participating iteration, 24*sum(P_chunk) per row, zero for an empty stream; bytes are shared by both integer sums. Allocations are in function entry and reused across chunks/rows, independent of total runtime trips. Two retained integer carries and three reduction carries are exercised. The existing three-stream historical examples reserve C=64/B=1024 at ceiling 1043; single i32 streams reserve C=64/B=256 at ceiling 259. Validation-only probes reread inputs and compute independent expected results; that traffic is not generated compiler traffic. Physical stack use, spills, RVV traffic and speedup are not measured.
limitations: This worker has not built LLVM, invoked compilers, run lit/unit/executable tests, machine-verified modules or compiled the primary corpus. Only source/diff/immutable-result review, Python AST parsing and whitespace inspection are allowed here. Every new result remains pending independent harness validation. Chunking still excludes affine/relational/reversed-equality control, multiple participation sites, nonterminal updates and unsupported CFG/effects/accumulator feedback. Multi-block unconditional producers keep their existing no-chunk restriction; no d2 changes are imported. New numerical producer state uses i32 with finite FP inputs including signed zero; inherited exceptional-FP cases remain. Existing state/FP/export/poison tests remain mandatory. The new narrow i8 fixture executes scalar consumers under both policies and LV1/LV2; scalable vectorization may conservatively leave it scalar, and its separate vector-policy lit/codegen run does not assert a vector width. i64 fixtures require actually entered vector consumers when fixed-vscale lanes fit capacity. EVL remains uninstrumented RVV codegen/machine verification only; host execution covers scalar and vector/scalar-tail layouts at fixed vscale, never RVV execution. No fast-math/errno assumptions, target speedup or newly selected immutable original target is claimed.
